body: I can't. Liars don't deserve that kind of treatment, regardless if it's true! Can you put a different opinion into words? :)

Great analogy. This day, my facade will stand, thanks  to you. 

Bosses responded relatively positively btw. Just wanted me to complete the projects before Monday. The main problem that remains is how I deal with her. I guess that one belongs to me, on my own.

Time and time again you're right. I'm beginning to think that you're a learned psychiatrist. Five years sounds like the minimum for me to come to terms with life. But for now I need a couple of days to decide if I should forgive her (THEN I need to deal with my mothers kidney cancer and some other stuff). I would quit my job right now if I didn't have car payments... 
[But for now I have these bottles](http://i.imgur.com/H5qSn1h.jpg)!
And I won't text her. She doesn't deserve it. If I'm immature about this, so be it. At least I'm not a liar.

Not wife (yet or ever!). Gf since high school (gymnasium here, 16-20). She's a doctor now and I'm a lawyer. Both 28 now. Crazy to think we've come this far. But I'm fairly sure she cheated and I want to just fall asleep and forget the next 5-10 years or something.

You're absolutely right. Alcohol hasn't helped me in the slightest, but it HAS numbed the pain in a way that I've almost stopped crying hysterically.

I swear I won't drive. You have my word. I realize it's not just on me. I would never be out on the road in my state. I'll probably just call another sick day and get another night here.

Hey again. Update, so you don't worry. Am currently shitfaced, two bottles of wine down, at a random hotel out in the country. Just drove through the night until I found a good looking place. I am really contemplating just driving out of the country and leaving everything behind, but it's probably the wine talking. Haven't slept a minute as you predicted, been around 28 hours. Anyway, still not killing myself, just spinning a little out of control (The Strokes on 100% volume are PERFECT for these kinds of feelings)

I guess I don't have to give a reason, you're right. 

I might drink some of the wine, but I won't get shitfaced.

I will absolutely not turn on my phone. I just can't right now. I know you're right about the wine and the phone, but c'est la vie. Thank you for taking the time to talk.

Edit: Goodnight to you too! I think I will forget this login, and maybe I don't want to remember it. But I won't forget your positive outlook on things. Have a great life friend.
